name: Scan header
region: hu.json from scan-intake: voxel spacing (z, y, x, mm), shape, calibration evidence and the grid id every later step uses

name: Orientation frame
region: frame.json from orient-joint: the shaft axes, the bending plane and the keyframe the oriented stack is cut on

name: Scan
region: hu.npy from scan-intake, in HU, with the affine from hu.json

name: Bone labels
region: labels.npy on the scan grid; the bones below are values in it

name: Segmentation disagreement
region: disagreement.npy from disagree.py on the scan grid: the regions where your labels and the classic method's differ, for To check items to point at

name: Aligned tibia grid
region: the tibia resampled onto the oriented grid; the regions and surfaces below sit on it

name: ROI-1 (IIOC)
region: the voxels measured for deck #4-6: growth plate to articular surface

name: ROI-2 (IIOC trabecular)
region: the voxels measured for deck #13-15

name: ROI-3 (metaphyseal)
region: the voxels measured for deck #16-23

name: Medial subchondral plate
region: the voxels measured for deck #11

name: Lateral subchondral plate
region: the voxels measured for deck #12

name: Cortex at 100 µm
region: the voxels measured for deck #24

name: Cortex at 1000 µm
region: the voxels measured for deck #25

name: Cortex
region: the cortical shell mask the cortical task reads

name: Articular surface
region: the top of the articular bone as a height field

name: Growth plate, proximal face
region: traced once; the later tasks read it

name: Growth plate, distal face
region: traced once; the later tasks read it

name: Under-plate boundary
region: the lower edge of the subchondral plate

name: DFL ruler
region: from point a to the intercondylar notch point b of deck #26

name: DFW ruler
region: from point c to point d of deck #27

name: IIOC height ruler
region: deck #7

name: Medial IIOC height ruler
region: deck #8

name: Lateral IIOC height ruler
region: deck #9

name: Tibial width ruler
region: deck #10

name: Patella volume
region: patella label, thresholded voxels

name: Lateral meniscus/osteophyte volume
region: lateral meniscus and its spurs together, one volume per side (the lab cannot separate them); on OA6-1RK label 6. Open: whether label 9's pieces and tibial margin fragments 10 and 11 count

name: Medial meniscus/osteophyte volume
region: medial meniscus and its spurs together, one volume per side (the lab cannot separate them); on OA6-1RK label 5. Open: whether label 9's pieces and tibial margin fragments 10 and 11 count

name: Bone threshold
region: the HU threshold that separates bone from soft tissue in the segmentation (review derives the bone inside a region from it)

name: TV, tibial IIOC
region: ROI-1: growth plate to articular surface

name: BV, tibial IIOC
region: ROI-1

name: BV/TV, tibial IIOC
region: ROI-1

name: IIOC height
region: middle of the growth plate to the top of the articular bone, vertical

name: IIOC height, medial compartment
region: as #7, medial

name: IIOC height, lateral compartment
region: as #7, lateral

name: Tibial width at the growth plate
region: centre of the fibula–tibia junction on the tibial surface to the prominent point on the other side (open question for the lab: confirm the endpoints on one annotated scan)

name: Subchondral bone plate thickness, medial
region: medial plate

name: Subchondral bone plate thickness, lateral
region: lateral plate

name: TV, IIOC-trab
region: ROI-2: ROI-1 minus the subchondral plate and the cortical line next to the growth plate

name: BV, IIOC-trab
region: ROI-2

name: BV/TV, IIOC-trab
region: ROI-2

name: TV, proximal tibial trabeculae
region: ROI-3: from 50 µm below the growth plate, 200 µm long, 20 µm clear of cortical bone

name: BV, proximal tibial trabeculae
region: ROI-3

name: BV/TV, proximal tibial trabeculae
region: ROI-3

name: Tb.N, proximal tibial trabeculae
region: ROI-3

name: Tb.Th, proximal tibial trabeculae
region: ROI-3, largest contained sphere

name: Tb.Sp, proximal tibial trabeculae
region: ROI-3, largest contained sphere in marrow

name: Tb.Nd, trabecular nodes
region: ROI-3, 3D skeleton junctions of ≥3 struts (the lab reports a count per tissue volume)

name: Tb.Tm, trabecular ends
region: ROI-3, skeleton free ends (the lab reports a count per tissue volume)

name: Cortical thickness, 100 µm below the growth plate
region: cortical shell at that level

name: Cortical thickness, 1000 µm below the growth plate
region: as #24

name: Distal femoral length (DFL)
region: midpoint (a) of the upper line of the intercondylar groove to the intercondylar notch (b)

name: Distal femoral width (DFW)
region: midpoint (c) of the ridge on the lateral condyle surface to the vertex (d) of the medial condyle (open question for the lab: confirm the endpoints on one annotated scan)
